title: Contract Manifest
description: Schema for contracts/MANIFEST.yaml (and, sans approval, contracts/DRAFT_MANIFEST.yaml): the approved set of behavioral contracts plus the forgery-resistant approval block. Distinct from receipts/manifest.json (which carries the parity `claim`). Ties #7 (approval.manifest_hash transitively binds contract bodies via per-entry content_hash) and #5 (contracts_covered enumerates these entries) together. approval.manifest_hash is computed over the canonical JSON of THIS document with the `approval` block removed; see references/approval-verification.md. A validator must have approval.schema.json registered to resolve the $ref.

run_id.description: Optional link to the choreography run (runs.run_id / task_store.db) this manifest belongs to.

source_ref.description: Optional source identifier (path/url/repo) the contracts were derived from.

contracts.description: The approved contracts. Each entry binds a contract file by content hash so the manifest hash transitively covers contract bodies (no post-approval contract edits).

tombstones.description: TOMBSTONES.md anchors for approved divergences/waivers recorded in this manifest.

approval.description: Forgery-resistant approval block. OPTIONAL in the schema so DRAFT_MANIFEST.yaml validates; the Phase II->III/IV gate REQUIRES it present and live-verified (SKILL.md Approval Gate, rule #3).

path.description: Path to the contract file, e.g. contracts/cid-packs-create-001.yaml.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the contract file. Recomputed at the gate; any drift => manifest_hash mismatch => gate refuses (#7) and the contract counts as uncovered (#5).

linked_requirements.description: Optional echo of the contract's baseline IDs for at-a-glance traceability. Hierarchical/namespaced form per the locked §9 ID strategy (e.g. BACKEND.BILLING.F-003); bare F-003 still valid. Mirrors contract.schema.json -- the two patterns move together.
